annotations.title: Make a payment method the default

description:
Make a payment method the default

Makes one of your stored payment methods the default, so future card payments of your account use it. Use it before `remove_payment_method` when the current default should go, because the default cannot be removed. `paymentMethodId` is an `id` from `list_payment_methods`, which also shows the current default in `defaultPaymentMethodId`. A new card can only be added in the dashboard. 400 when the account has no stored card details yet.
name: set_default_payment_method
title: Make a payment method the default
